services.name: Sunset Shared
services.desc: When you book a sunset hot air balloon ride with us, you’re in for an unforgettable experience. Our sunset hot air balloon rides are great for those who want to see the beauty of Seattle while avoiding the crowds. You’ll have the chance to get up close with the majestic Mt. Rainier, the white river, the green river, and Lake Tapps. Our sunset hot air balloon rides are perfect for those looking for an adventure without having to get up at the crack of dawn. Sunset hot air balloon rides are a great option for celebrating a birthday, anniversary, graduation, or any other special occasion. services.name: Balloon Glows
services.desc: As you approach the Muckleshoot Casino, you’ll feel the excitement building inside you. You are about to embark on an adventure like no other - a hot air balloon ride over the stunning landscapes of the Pacific Northwest. Once you arrive at the casino, your experienced pilot will greet you and provide a safety orientation. Then, you’ll hop into the chase vans and head out to the balloon launch site. As you travel to the launch site, your pilot will share fascinating stories about the history of hot air ballooning, providing insight into this incredible ballooning adventure. Upon arrival at the launch site, your expert ballooning crew will begin preparing the hot air balloon for takeoff.

blurb: Seattle Ballooning offers hot air balloon rides launching just south of Seattle, designed to showcase Mt. Rainier with views of the Cascade and Olympic Mountains, Puget Sound, and local lakes. Flights last about 60 minutes with the whole experience around 2.5 hours. They offer shared and private flights for groups from 2 to 10 passengers, with corporate and special event options.
